title: re-verified fixed: schema_at_least coerces via to_int at :922 and cmd_migrate_schema at :1949-1951, and all thirteen .schema_version reads now reach arithmetic only through those two guards
re-verified fixed: all seven .current_phase reads coerce inside the jq filter, so no state-file value reaches a bash arithmetic context
test:smoke-bash32 now installs via apk add --no-cache jq git and asserts bash 3.2 at :303; no apt-get remains anywhere in the pipeline
L8 half fixed: every scratch path now uses ${TMPDIR:-/tmp} or nests under a trapped $TMP, and the /tmp/edm-cg-bogus.$$ symlink-hazard redirect is gone
each pinned digest is now spelled exactly once, in the .alpine_edm and .node_edm anchors, and every job consumes them by merge
state_file_for now applies the same slug regex to EDM_PRODUCT and EDM_DESCRIPTION before interpolating them into the path
cmd_watch_impl now probes --is-inside-work-tree and a resolvable HEAD before the poll loop and fails loudly on both

partially fixed: the BSD-incompatible mktemp template is gone but the trap is still RETURN-only and the T61 AC11 divergence sweep at wave7-smoke.sh:759-770 still covers only bin/ and only four patterns, so the class can regress in evals/ unseen

the commit hook still hardcodes ^SRD/ and the awk $2/$3 field indices; the gap was documented at edm-lint-artifacts:44-46 but not fixed, and wave7-smoke.sh:3370 still asserts the literal hardcoded matcher

seven shellcheck-disable directives landed and cover the round-1 sites, but the job still loops unconditionally over bin/* against a comment claiming new/modified code only, and the unquoted ${include_archived:+...} pair in list_state_files carries no directive

partially fixed: _now and _ms_between are guarded by command -v perl but --mermaid-ratio still calls perl -e unconditionally, so the mode still aborts under set -euo pipefail on the perl-less images the fallback exists for

partially fixed: the job-body extractor now resets on a pattern that matches colon-bearing job names, but the grep is still only curl/wget/anthropic.com, before_script installs are still invisible to it, and no positive control was added

unchanged: the comment still claims nothing grants unrestricted shell access and the run cannot reach outside the scratch tree, while :231 grants Bash(jq *) and Bash(edm-state *) under a literal-prefix matcher
unchanged: the five UserPromptExpansion hooks still apply no charset filter to $ARGUMENTS and still block expansion with a bare exit 1 and no message when it is empty
unchanged (moved to :438/:448): the filename-derived lens_n is still interpolated unescaped into a grep -E pattern, so a file named with a glob metacharacter skews dimension 5
re-confirmed noted: the two pinned digests and the bash:3.2 floating tag are still self-declared placeholders, documented and authorized in the file itself
re-confirmed noted: em dashes under bin/tests/ remain carved out of the ASCII sweep as comments never read as prompt text
re-confirmed noted and strengthened: set -- $list still glob-expands harmlessly and now carries an explicit shellcheck-disable with the bash-3.2 rationale at :184
re-confirmed noted: flock on fd 200 is deliberately above the bash-internal and BASH_XTRACEFD range, and a fresh full-scope sweep found no fd 9 or 10-19 use and no stdin-stealing read loop
re-confirmed noted: git add -A still operates only on a throwaway scratch repo, never the user's tree

the arithmetic-context injection class is still live on a second input channel: phase-start's unvalidated <phase-num> argument reaches [[ $((gated_phase + 1)) -eq "$phase" ]] via :1545, giving arbitrary execution to any caller holding only the Bash(edm-state *) prefix grant, including the eval driver's own allow-list

the perl-less _now fallback adds rand() to systime(), so on the perl-free images the fallback exists for every measured duration carries up to one second of random error and can be negative, in a harness whose header asserts no numbers are invented

write_atomic and with_state_lock interpolate a filesystem path into a single-quoted trap body, so an apostrophe in the install or project path makes the cleanup a syntax error at signal time (leaking a tracked-directory temp file and a stale lock) and a crafted path is trap-body injection

HUMAN_HOURLY_RATE_USD is spliced into jq program text rather than passed with --arg (every sibling use passes it as awk -v data), and neither it nor EDM_TOKEN_READ_LINE_CAP, which goes straight to tail -n, is validated at startup

eleven blocking jobs each resolve their toolchain from a mutable Alpine package index at run time on top of placeholder-digest images, so neither the image layer nor the package layer is actually pinned despite the header presenting pinning as the reproducibility story

lint:shellcheck covers only plugins/edm/bin/* -- not bin/tests/*.sh, which lint:bash-syntax does cover, and not plugins/edm/evals/*.sh, which nothing lints, which is the same blind spot that let the CA-014 mktemp template ship

the CA-001 migrate-schema guard's own comment claims a non-integer schema_version fails the -le check and is reported, but coercing to 0 makes that check false, so the value is silently normalised to 1 and :2002 prints the coerced value rather than the corrupt one
